Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was excited about the latency profile and the quantization options for inference. I promised to share a light mutual action plan (MAP) and a pragmatic legal sequencing option to unblock a pilot while legal and procurement finish the MSA/DPA review.

Attached: Aurelion-MAP-v1.3.xlsx (MAP with milestones), Aurelion-SOC2-answers.pdf (security Qs)

- Step 2 (Legal finish): MSA and DPA to be executed within the pilot window; if final terms differ materially, we include an agreed remediation path.

Why this helps: procurement can get capacity and engineering time scheduled immediately; legal gets full redline time without delaying engineering.

Can you confirm procurement is OK with order-form-first for limited scope? If yes, we’ll:
- Send a redline-friendly order form with acceptance criteria and SOC/Security evidence links.

1) You confirm procurement appetite (today)
2) We provide an order form for signature (EOD Mon)
3) Legal sends MSA/DPA redline tracker and target sign date (we propose +30 days)

Open to alternatives — want to make this low-friction.

Hannah / Jordan —

Quick legal play to respond to procurement constraints (see Cara’s note). I ran a short options list with Counsel; recommended path below (low risk, keeps pilot on schedule):

Proposed conditional-signature path (diagram attached: signature-path-diagram.png):
- Phase A: Execute Order Form (pilot-specific) with the following mandatory elements:
  * Limited scope definition (datasets, seats, token cap)
  * Pilot-only liabilities (caps on damages for pilot period)
  * Explicit opt-out/termination clause at pilot end; no auto-renew without MSA
  * Acceptance criteria tied to MAP milestones (we own the checklist)
- Phase B: Simultaneous redline of MSA + DPA. Parties commit in the OF to good-faith negotiation and target execution date (+30 days).
- Phase C: If MSA/DPA execution results in material changes to pricing or core obligations, the parties will use a pre-agreed remediation path: either (i) amend the OF within 10 business days, or (ii) roll back to termination with limited remedies.

Notes / risk controls:
- This is commercially equivalent to the common pilot-first approach. It reduces the risk of an open-ended obligation because the OF controls scope and the opt-out.
- We should include a specific data handling addendum in the OF referencing the DPA controls to avoid procurement objections on data protection.
- I will draft the OF language and the short remediation clause. Jordan, can you flag any commercial constraints (pricing floors, discounts) to ensure OF language aligns with the sales terms?
